{{Quote|The workmanship of those permits should be as high as the craftmanship you now hold in your hands.|[[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Amber Comark]] to [[Ordomire|"Lucky" Ordomire]] upon giving up her brooch|<ref name="DH">{{JournalCite|9|Death-Hunter}}</ref>}}
The '''Comark Brooch''' was a family heirloom of the Comark family. It was passed down to the females of the family, and during the height of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], it had come into the possession of [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Amber Comark]], who received it on her birthday. The brooch had the Comark family crest incribed on the back. During [[Operation Death-Hunter]], Comark gave the brooch to the forger [[Ordomire|"Lucky" Ordomire]] in exchange for forged [[Scavenger/Legends|salvager]] permits for the [[Imperial Trade and Commerce Authority]].<ref name="DH" />
